description: The offer for an After Hours AI phone receptionist on the owner's own business line, prepaid and billed per minute: min40: 40 minutes for $10; min200: 200 minutes for $50 ($0.25 a minute). Real answered phone calls cost $0.25 per minute, billed by the second: each call rounds up to the next whole second, with a 20-second minimum. Robocalls, calls from your own numbers or ours, website and widget chats, text messages, and calls whose transcripts cannot be read are not charged. At zero the line keeps answering and usage goes below zero; your next pack pays that balance first. You are emailed at 5 minutes left, at zero, and at 10 minutes below zero. Nothing switches the line off automatically. Or Pay per resolved conversation: USD 0.49 each, prepaid in packs of 50 (USD 24.50) or 200 (USD 98). A message taken or a booking made counts; everything else is free. At zero the line keeps answering in message-only mode and texts the owner once where owner texts are enabled (otherwise email). No balance goes below zero; buy another outcome pack to restore bookings. Outcome packs: out50: 50 resolved conversations for $24.50; out200: 200 resolved conversations for $98. Offered in: US. Use it before set_up_answering_line, to tell the owner exactly what they would buy. Needs no sign-in, reads no account and changes nothing.
